Check out the exact baseline and extract the increment at the repository root; never apply it over a newer tree.
Validate all 33 path sizes and SHA-256 values listed in the increment manifest.
Run check_route_orbit_barrier.py, JSON validation, integration navigation validation and the fresh effective-map audit.
Require nine relations, five route-swap orbits, joint-target distribution 4/4/1, zero same-orbit joint/distributed contrasts, and science tree 7dc5a6480e7b41ce4465ccaed6e77044019b360a.
Do not treat the incremental package as a complete repository, working set or history.
